From your watch, through Health Connect. Change it to log the night yourself.
Novila can fill in your nights from a watch or another app through Health Connect. What you log yourself always comes first.
What may have affected the night?
Log your nights and days for a couple of weeks, and Novila finds what affects your sleep. %1$d of %2$d nights logged.
Nothing stands out in your logs yet. Novila only shows a link when your nights clearly differ.
From your own logs, on your phone. A link isn\'t proof of cause.
A bedtime to aim for, an evening routine and advice from your own nights.
Choose a bedtime to aim for and a wind-down routine for the evening. Novila looks at your own nights and suggests habits that tend to help sleep. Everything stays on your phone.
When do you want to be in bed?
When do you want to wake up?
Pick the steps you want in your evening. Novila shows them at the right time before your bedtime.

%1$d of %2$d nights near your bedtime goal
What Novila sees in your nights
Your nights are close to your goal. Keep the rhythm you have.
From your own logs, on your phone. A tip is advice, not a diagnosis.
Your bedtimes vary. Aim to be in bed within half an hour of your goal, night after night.
Your wake-up times vary. A steady wake time is the best anchor for your sleep.
You spend a long time awake in bed. If sleep won\'t come, get up, do something calm and return when you feel sleepy. Keep the bed for sleep.
Your nights have been shorter than your goal. Keep your wake time steady and go to bed only when you feel sleepy.
You have often had caffeine late. Try your last cup at least six hours before bedtime.
You have often had screens in bed. Screens off before bed makes it easier to wind down.
You have often logged alcohol before a night. Alcohol makes sleep more broken in the second half of the night.
You have often logged stress before a night. Write down what is on your mind before bed, so it stays on paper.
You have often eaten late. Finish heavy meals two to three hours before bedtime.
You have often trained late. Hard training is best at least two hours before bed.
Add an evening routine in the coach, and it shows the next step here.
The evening\'s steps are done. Sleep well.
A few calm minutes before bed: calm breathing, box breathing or 4-7-8.
